title: ALMA Multi-line Observations of the IR-bright Merger VV 114
question: Distribution and kinematics of diffuse and dense molecular gas in the merger VV 114, and spatial variation of excitation conditions across the two merging disks

data.arrays: 14-20 12 m antennas, compact and extended configurations
data.sensitivity: 30 km/s channel rms 1.0 mJy/beam (B3), 0.8 mJy/beam (B7); continuum 0.05, 0.11, 0.07 mJy/beam

what.value: Single-dish/SMA/JCMT fluxes used for missing-flux estimates and dust temperature 39.4 K

evidence.quote: The estimated missing flux in our ALMA observation is 21 $\pm$ 1 % (cite: wil08; sai13).

recipe.method: CASA clean with Briggs (uniform for CO 3-2), uv continuum subtraction, primary beam correction, 5 or 30 km/s channels
Match uv range and beam, convolve, convert to K km/s, sum in 2.0'' R boxes and 1.2'' S boxes, ratio where both >3 sigma; multi-Gaussian fits to spectra

recipe.goal: Derive H2 and dense gas masses
assumptions: alpha_CO = 0.8; alpha_HCN = 10; uncertainty up to factor of two

recipe.method: RADEX grid in Tkin, nH2, N(H2) (case 1) or [HCN]/[HCO+] (case 2); chi2 minimization
key_parameters: Case 1: Tkin 5-300 K step 5, n 10^2-10^5; case 2: Tkin 5-400 K, n 10^3-10^7

recipe.goal: LTE filling factor, Tex, column density, abundances
recipe.method: Tex from CO(1-0) with Phi=Tb/Tkin; optical depth and column density equations
assumptions: 13CO and CO from same cloud; 12CO(1-0) optically thick

recipe.goal: Dust and ISM mass from 340 GHz continuum
recipe.method: Dust mass equation (wil08) and Scoville et al. 2014 RJ-tail ISM mass; compare with M_H2

evidence.quote: The total $^{12}$CO (1–0) integrated intensity of VV 114 is 594.6 $\pm$ 1.6 Jy km s$^{-1}$
The $R_{3-2/1-0}$ of VV 114 varies from 0.2 to 0.8

answer_key.quantity: Molecular gas mass at R38 (tidal arm tip)
Tkin at R21a (eastern nucleus), best fit

evidence.quote: constrained to within 25 – 90 K (the best fit is 50 K)

answer_key.quantity: Missing flux 340 GHz continuum vs JCMT

evidence.quote: The estimated missing flux relative to the JCMT 340 GHz observation (cite: wil08) is 75 $\pm$ 4 %

not_stated_but_needed: Briggs robust value for each cube
CASA version and clean parameters (threshold, masks, iterations)
Exact box positions and Gaussian fit details
RADEX script details (line widths, chi2 error budget)
Pa-alpha extinction correction and SFR calibration choices
missing_for_reproduction: Briggs robust, clean parameters, line-free channels
score_reason: Public data and many numeric tables, but imaging parameters and RADEX setup partly unstated.
rediscovery_reason: Public Cycle 0 data, tabulated numeric results (line ratios, masses), mostly standard recipe.
